answer_1.quote: The subjective role-playing agent simulates the behavior of a social media user ... generate a new comment at the future time of interest t′ regarding the event.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the performance of sentiment forecasting with real-world data on both microscopic and macroscopic levels. The microscopic evaluation measures ... accuracy and Macro F1 scores. The macroscopic evaluation ... Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD).

answer_3.quote: We finetune an objective psychologist LLM to critically analyze the generated comments ... The objective LLM would determine if the generated comment demonstrates consistency.

answer_4.quote: We enlisted three experts in behavioral psychology. The experts were asked to independently assess whether the LLM‑s‑generated comments maintained a consistent textual tone of voice and reasonably coherent attitude flow.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate consistency of textual tone of voice and coherence of attitude flow in the generated comments.
